defaultStyle: Top-down 2D twin-stick survival game sprite viewed from directly overhead (bird's-eye view, 90 degrees), gritty illustrated style with muted earthy palette and selective blood-red accents, transparent background, single object only, centered composition, no text, no UI, no drop shadow, consistent lighting across all assets, 256x256 target size

assets.name: Player Survivor
assets.description: A lone survivor viewed from directly overhead, facing up, wearing a brown leather jacket over a grey hoodie, dark tactical pants, visible shoulders and the top of a backpack, holding a pistol with both hands extended forward, clearly the player character

assets.name: Zombie Walker
assets.description: A shambling zombie viewed from directly overhead, arms outstretched forward, dingy torn grey clothing, pale rotten skin, streaks of old blood, similar size to the player, clearly the basic zombie variant

assets.name: Zombie Runner
assets.description: A lean fast infected runner viewed from directly overhead, thin frame in shredded athletic clothing, one arm swung back mid-stride, slightly smaller and leaner than the walker, clearly a fast-moving variant

assets.name: Zombie Brute
assets.description: A massive muscular infected brute viewed from directly overhead, huge shoulders, ragged chains of torn hospital gown, one oversized fist raised, visibly larger than the walker and runner, clearly a heavy boss-type enemy

assets.name: Pistol Pickup
assets.description: A dark metal 9mm pistol viewed from directly overhead, resting flat, barrel pointing up, clearly a ground-loot weapon pickup

assets.name: Shotgun Pickup
assets.description: A pump-action shotgun with a wooden stock and dark metal barrel viewed from directly overhead, resting flat, barrel pointing up, noticeably longer than the pistol

assets.name: Ammo Box
assets.description: A small olive-green metal ammunition crate viewed from directly overhead, showing the latched top with a stenciled bullet icon in yellow, clearly a resource pickup

assets.name: Medical Kit
assets.description: A white medical kit viewed from directly overhead, showing a bold red cross on the lid, clean latching edges, clearly a healing pickup

assets.name: Blood Splatter
assets.description: A messy dark crimson blood splatter viewed from directly overhead, irregular pooled center with radial droplets and streaks, semi-transparent edges, clearly a ground-decal effect

assets.name: Grass Tile
assets.description: A seamlessly tileable square grass ground tile viewed from directly overhead, dry yellowed grass with patches of darker dirt and scattered small rocks, designed to tile edge-to-edge in both directions, NOT transparent

assets.name: Road Tile
assets.description: A seamlessly tileable square cracked asphalt road tile viewed from directly overhead, dark grey with visible cracks, faint yellow paint fragments, scattered pebbles, designed to tile edge-to-edge in both directions, NOT transparent
